verdict.summary: The workflow now CAS-adopts dispatcher-owned review/fix claims into a run-specific holder, refreshes the lease for the lane budget, and fails closed when the claim is expired, mismatched, or already adopted. The existing post-adoption validation and failure release are consistent with the transferred ownership. The added workflow extractor pins both lane TTLs and the essential --adopt/--holder/--ttl wiring, while its mutation checks demonstrate that TTL drift and regressions to inspection or missing holder wiring are observable. I found no diff-scoped correctness, security, or test-validity defect.
